ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْ بِسِرِّهِ اسْتَقَامَتِ الْبَرَازِخُ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī bi sirrihi ‘staqāmati ‘l-barāzikh.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the one by whose secret interim states are kept in order!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ عَدَدَ كُلِّ مَنْسُوْخٍ وَنَاسِخٍ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, `Adada kulli mansūkhin wa nāsikh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the number of everything abrogated and abrogating!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَعَمِّرْ قُلُوْبَنَا بِالنُّوْرِ الرَّاسِخِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa `ammir qulūbanā bi ‘n-Nūri ‘r-rāsikh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and refurbish our hearts with firmly established light!
